Item Class: Augment
Rarity: Currency
Greater Iron Rune
--------
Stack Size: 1/10
--------
Requires: Level 30
--------
Martial Weapon: 18% increased Physical Damage
Wand or Staff: 30% increased Spell Damage
Armour: 18% increased Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield
--------
Place into an empty Augment Socket in a Weapon or Armour to apply its effect to that item. Once socketed it cannot be retrieved but can be replaced by other Augment items.
--------
Shift click to unstack.
